# KM Companion version

Use the version shown in **Settings**, or give the commit when testing source.

# ROM hack profile and generation

Name the selected profile and its base generation.

# Area

Name the screen or workflow, such as startup profile selection, calculation controls, Team/Box, save import, trainer data, battle simulator, Settings, updates, installation, or uninstall.

# Steps to reproduce

List the shortest repeatable steps.

# Expected behavior

What should KM Companion have done?

# Actual behavior

What happened instead?

# Diagnostics

Paste only the relevant error text. Replace local account names and private folder names with neutral placeholders.

# Screenshots

Add screenshots only when they clarify the issue. Crop or redact account names, local paths, notifications, save details, and unrelated applications.

# File safety

Do not attach ROMs, game dumps, console keys, executable game files, copyrighted assets, private saves, credentials, signing material, personal data, complete generated mods, or private trainer research.
